concerns.text: The plan proposes generating 1 000 permutations per window and computing autocorrelations for all lags h ≤ ⌊L/2⌋ via FFT for each permutation. For the largest interval (L = 10⁵) this entails ~50 k lags per window and 1 000 FFTs per window, resulting in billions of FFT operations across 300 windows. This far exceeds the CPU‑only, 2‑core, ≤6 h runtime budget of the GitHub Actions free tier and likely breaches the ≤7 GB RAM limit when handling the permutation data. The methodology is therefore infeasible under the project's compute constraints and must be revised (e.g., reduce number of permutations, limit lags, or batch windows).
